An Artifact Type is a versioned contract T for one artifact kind.
T binds at least one semantic Definition, a closed machine schema, canonical-source direction, deterministic human projection, validation rules, owner route, lifecycle posture, and claim ceiling.
Registration of T neither defines its subject meaning nor admits T or any instance.
